(a) Balinese metaphors are constructed through the mapping process, (b) the mapping process is based on similarity of character or systems between source and target domain (Balinese and flora), (c) the mapping process also based on the bodily experience of Balinese people in their cognitive process, and (d) the Balinese metaphor was constructed through ecolinguistics parameter.
the Balinese metaphorical expressions were mostly constructed by mapping process, and the metaphors were also created by human's cognitive process which was based on human's bodily experience.

the relationship between language and environment.
how Balinese language users use the lexicons of Balinese flora in constructing metaphorical expressions.
the ecolinguistic analysis of Balinese metaphors that are related to flora.
